warp.bot: Use this to obtain source-backed facts before creating a client update. For Cloudflare, report unique visitors and page views exactly as returned. For google_search_console, report search.clicks and search.impressions — these are Search Console metrics, not site analytics visitors. Resource for Cloudflare is the 32-char zone tag; for Google Search Console use sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/.

en.question: Does this estimate visitors?
en.answer: No. For Cloudflare it reports unique visitors and page views from analytics. For Google Search Console it reports search clicks and impressions — not site analytics visitors.

de.question: Schätzt dies Besucher?
de.answer: Nein. Bei Cloudflare liefert es Unique Visitors und Seitenaufrufe aus Analytics. Bei Google Search Console liefert es Suchklicks und Impressionen — keine Website-Analytics-Besucher.

warp.bot: Add a website with team + name. Optional url and type. type=shop requires url and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team; brandless records only). Omit type or pass type=undefined for a normal website/portfolio record. Do not pass slug — it is generated from the name. Optionally pass contactId, metricsSource (cloudflare | google_search_console), metricsResource (Cloudflare zone tag or GSC property URL), and monthlyReport=true to opt into the 1st-of-month report job (does not send now). If enabling monthlyReport returns channel_not_configured, call settings-integration-open with integration=cloudflare or google-search-console matching the metrics source, then retry. Use site-provision when the site should be live on a Warp brand.

en.answer: No. It stores a website record you can report on. Use site-provision for a live brand site.

en.question: What does type shop do?
en.answer: After payment, the JoAi thank-you page redirects buyers to that site URL.

de.question: Veröffentlicht dies eine Live-App auf sites.joai.ai?

de.question: Wofür ist Typ shop?
de.answer: Nach der Zahlung leitet die JoAi-Danke-Seite Käufer zu dieser Website-URL zurück.

warp.bot: Update site fields including optional type. type=shop requires url, only works on brandless sites, and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team). Pass type=undefined (or empty) to clear shop. Pass metricsSource (cloudflare | google_search_console) and metricsResource together (Cloudflare zone tag or GSC property URL like sc-domain:example.com / https://example.com/). monthlyReport=true opts into the 1st-of-month job when contact and metrics are set — it does not send immediately.
